metadata.description: Collection of Claude Code plugins by ivlad003 — observability, DevOps, and developer productivity tools

plugins.name: newrelic-observability
plugins.description: Query and analyze New Relic observability data directly from Claude Code via REST API calls. Includes NRQL queries, entity search, alerts, deployments, infrastructure metrics, and incident investigation workflows.

plugins.name: datadog-observability
plugins.description: Query and analyze Datadog observability data directly from Claude Code via REST API calls. Includes log search, metrics queries, monitors, events, host infrastructure, and incident investigation workflows.
